outcome: Congenital anterior dislocation of the sacrococcygeal bone
cohort: A newborn child who was transported to the Neurosurgery Clinic for a spinal myelomeningocele surgical procedure.
finding: An extremely rare congenital anterior dislocation of the sacrococcygeal bone was unexpectedly visualized during follow-up imaging in a newborn being treated for myelomeningocele.
followup_time: The patient did not attend required follow-up examinations, so no specific long-term follow-up time is reported.
